notes.subject: בין שורתם
notes.rationale: 'Between their walls' (KJV) vs 'within the rows' (JPS, shur as row of olive trees) vs 'their walls' as the oppressors' property.

notes.subject: ⟨long en⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin needs the preposition; the Hebrew verb דרכו carries 'tread' alone.

notes.subject: יצהירו / ויצמאו
notes.rationale: Pressing oil vs thirsting — the workers make the rich liquids yet lack water; irony kept by juxtaposition.

translation: Namel long ol banis bilong ol, ol i pesautim ⟨את⟩ oil; ol patu bilong wain ol i tramap ⟨long en⟩, na ol i hangre long wara.

tokens.gloss: na ol i hangre long wara
